source_name: GOV.UK, Tax your vehicle (vehicle tax reminder V11)
text:
From: DVLA <noreply@notifications.service.gov.uk>
Subject: Vehicle tax reminder: AB12 CDE

Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency
Your vehicle tax for AB12 CDE (FORD FIESTA) runs out on 31 October 2026.
Tax your vehicle online at www.gov.uk/vehicle-tax using the 16 digit reference number: 1234 5678 9012 3456
You can also tax your vehicle by calling 0300 123 4321 or at a Post Office that deals with vehicle tax.
If you do not tax your vehicle or make a SORN, you'll be fined £80.
Do not reply to this email.
notes: Written by us from the public template or description at source_url for the false-positive hunt (2026-09-30). Names, numbers and references are placeholders; official contacts are the ones the organisation publishes. Not a verbatim copy of a real message.
